clue.text: An office in which little or no work gets done

definitions.text: An office in which little or no work gets done

parts.words: An office in which little or no work gets done
parts.note: a straight description of a paid post with no real duties, offered as if it were a riddle

explanation.definitionFit: A post that pays its holder while asking almost nothing of them is the classic cushy job.

clue.text: An Arab or a Jew can make it seem different

indicators.note: making the letters different means rearranging them into a new word

explanation.surface: A remark that one ethnic label can be made to look like another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges the six letters of IT SEEM. Both Arabs and Jews are Semitic peoples, so either fits the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Semitic peoples include both Arabs and Jews, so a member of either group qualifies.

clue.text: Character of the phenomena of this world

explanation.definitionFit: A person's inborn temperament is their essential make-up; the physical world and all its phenomena is the natural world.

clue.text: A touching display of affection

parts.note: touching reads as moving, but here it is literal: a display of affection done by physical contact

explanation.definitionFit: A gentle stroke is affection shown by touch.

clue.text: Venturesome savings group?

parts.note: savings group suggests a thrift club, but savings here are people saved, by a brave squad that ventures out

explanation.definitionFit: A brave squad sent to save people in danger performs 'savings' in the sense of rescues.

clue.text: Bleach at the time that it comes in

indicators.note: the word it comes in, that is, sits inside the word for 'at the time'

parts.note: when means at the time that

explanation.surface: An instruction about when to apply bleach to the laundry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bleach' is the definition at the start; 'that' is only a link joining the two halves of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To bleach something is to make it paler, a synonym for making it lighter in colour.

clue.text: Two musical instruments join in the dance

parts.note: a horn is a brass musical instrument
a pipe is a simple wind instrument

explanation.surface: Two players bring their instruments to accompany a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: One phrase gives both pieces; 'join in' is the link. The answer is a lively solo dance associated with sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailor's jig-like solo step is a traditional form of dancing.

clue.text: All in fighting?

parts.note: all-in fighting suggests a wrestling style with no rules, but read it as all-out war involving every resource

explanation.definitionFit: A conflict in which a nation commits every resource and spares nothing is all-out warfare.

clue.text: Tells of a revolutionary Hebridean island set-up

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned round, so the island name is read backwards

parts.note: Arran is a Scottish island, here loosely called Hebridean

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word set is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: set means a set as written

explanation.surface: A story about a rebellious island community and how it was organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns ARRAN into NARRA and 'up' turns SET into TES. Arran actually lies in the Firth of Clyde, not the Hebrides.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount a story is to give an account of it, the sense of 'tells of'.

clue.text: A lock with a dull finish required for the bedroom?

parts.note: a mat or matt finish is a dull, non-glossy one
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Decorating advice: a lock fitted with a matt finish for the bedroom door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lock' suggests a door fitting, but it is a lock of hair. The charade is in answer order: MAT then TRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: The cushioned pad that goes on a bed is a bedroom essential.

clue.text: A personage of good address

parts.note: good address suggests a smart postcode, but address here means a speech, so this is a person who speaks well

explanation.definitionFit: A public speaker skilled in rhetoric delivers fine speeches.

clue.text: Go off and become a cynic, apparently

explanation.definitionFit: Milk that goes off curdles; a person who grows bitter and disillusioned also changes their outlook for the worse.

clue.text: Down-at-heel part of Italy

parts.note: down-at-heel means shabby, but read literally it is the region down at the heel of the Italian boot

explanation.definitionFit: The south-eastern region of Italy forms the heel of the boot-shaped peninsula.

clue.text: A conjurer whose identity isn't known?

definitions.text: A conjurer whose identity isn't known?

parts.words: A conjurer whose identity isn't known?
parts.note: a conjurer deals in mysteries, and an unknown person is an enigma: one phrase fits both

explanation.definitionFit: A stranger nobody can place is an enigma, and a magician is a performer of mysteries.

clue.text: Decide against early retirement

parts.note: early retirement suggests leaving work young, but retiring also means going to bed

explanation.definitionFit: Choosing not to go to bed early means remaining awake into the night.

clue.text: Strikingly good way of deal, ing with highballs?

definitions.text: way of deal, ing with highballs

explanation.definitionFit: Something excellent is terrific; in tennis a high lob is answered with a hard overhead shot.

clue.text: A compound that can pep up a space-traveller, pos, silly

parts.note: a steroid is a chemical compound, some kinds used to boost performance

explanation.surface: Worries about an astronaut taking performance-enhancing drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'space-traveller' suggests an astronaut; it is a rocky body orbiting the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor planet drifting through the solar system travels through space.

clue.text: Banished duke who did wonders for prose composition

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: composition means putting together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A literary figure praised for transforming the art of prose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' rearranges PROSE into SPERO. The answer is the exiled Duke of Milan and magician in Shakespeare's The Tempest.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's magician in The Tempest is the deposed ruler of Milan who works marvels on his island.

clue.text: Scoundrels creating bad scare when after-dinner sweets are about

indicators.note: the sweets are about, that is, around, the rearranged letters

parts.note: mints are often served after dinner

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters are spoilt and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Villains cause a fright when the after-dinner chocolates come round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' gives SCREA, an anagram of the given word; 'creating' and 'when' are link words, and the definition is the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: Villains and rogues are wrongdoers.

clue.text: One can't go right ahead and do it

definitions.text: One can't go right ahead and do it

parts.words: One can't go right ahead and do it
parts.note: go right ahead sounds like permission, but read literally it means continue straight on, which veering prevents

explanation.definitionFit: To veer suddenly aside is to fail to keep a straight course.

clue.text: How to make do?

parts.note: make do suggests managing with little, but it means to make someone do something

explanation.definitionFit: To force someone to act is to oblige them.

clue.text: Missing artist found in a place unfit for human inhabitation

indicators.note: the artist is found in, that is, inside, the place

parts.note: a sty is a pigs' pen, unfit for people
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter goes missing and turns up in a squalid hovel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Missing' looks like part of the story but is the definition: something gone missing has wandered off course. RA stands for Royal Academician.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gone off course is lost or wandering off the path.

clue.text: New sashes for Jenny

indicators.note: new tells you to form a new arrangement of the letters

explanation.walkthrough: 'Jenny' looks like a girl's name; a jenny is a female donkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A jenny is the female of the donkey.

clue.text: Take a gamble, as busy cartoonists do?

explanation.definitionFit: Choosing by chance is leaving it to fortune; prolific cartoonists sketch a great many pictures.

clue.text: Pressed on amid dire trouble

indicators.note: amid means in the middle of, so one piece goes inside the other
trouble means disturbance, so the letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: Someone presses on despite dire trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' gives IRED, an anagram of the given word, which then holds the other piece; 'Pressed' is the definition, in the sense of ironing clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes that have been pressed have been smoothed with a hot iron.

clue.text: Unseemly fellow who lassoes a spritely youngster?

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous sprite or child
a roper catches animals with a rope

explanation.surface: A cowboy wrangling a lively child behaves inappropriately.
explanation.walkthrough: The charade is in answer order: IMP then ROPER.
explanation.definitionFit: Unseemly behaviour is unbecoming or indecent.

clue.text: The church requires him to be sponsored

definitions.text: The church requires him to be sponsored

parts.words: The church requires him to be sponsored
parts.note: sponsored suggests a charity event, but at a christening a sponsor is a godparent

explanation.definitionFit: At baptism a boy is presented by godparents, who act as his sponsors.

clue.text: It won't get swept beneath the carpet

definitions.text: It won't get swept beneath the carpet

parts.words: It won't get swept beneath the carpet
parts.note: swept under the carpet means hidden, but the felt layer actually lies beneath the rug and is never brushed

explanation.definitionFit: The padding laid under a rug sits below it on the floor.
